attempts.summary: Configured a persistent Squid forward proxy on node1:3128 and the preserved legacy handbook origin on node2:8081. Only HTTP requests from node2 to node2:8081 are permitted; other destinations, ports, and CONNECT tunnels return 403. Both nodes restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot IDs. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.
